no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: On Sep 28, 2025, board determined to cease development of KPI-012 and the entire MSC-S platform after the Phase 2b CHASE trial in PCED missed its primary and key secondary endpoints. Workforce reduced ~51%, then in Sep/Oct 2025 substantially all remaining staff terminated following Oxford Finance default notice. Per the FY2025 10-K (filed April 2026): 'We do not have any ongoing clinical trials as of the date of this filing.' Company is in strategic transition, evaluating sale/license of legacy MSC-S assets (KPI-012, KPI-014) and developing an on-premises AI platform-as-a-service (Researgency, exclusively licensed from Younet AI on March 3, 2026).
